core_meaning.primary_meaning: Jal is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Great, majestic”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Jal corresponds to the Arabic form جل (Arabic root ج ل ل (j-l-l); جَلّ (Jall)). Its core sense is jal; great, majestic. Jal is Arabic جَلّ (Jall) 'great, majestic', from the root ج ل ل (j-l-l). The source gloss 'Gentle, kind' is unsupported and has been replaced with the lexical sense.
